title: service-bound-kms-proxy-and-contextual-rbac-assertions
author: Aisha Kumar
description:
Motivation: Customers operating in multi-region environments require finer-grained KMS routing and audit provenance without expanding operator superpowers. This PR introduces a service-bound KMS proxy component and a lightweight contextual RBAC assertion path (RBACv2) that allows callers to assert tenant- and request-scoped attributes used by the KMS allocator and audit enveloper.

Summary of changes (single-line continuous description): Added a kms-proxy service that terminates customer TLS, validates signed service-level claims, and rewrites KMS envelope metadata; implemented a contextual assertion evaluator in auth/rbacv2 that maps request attributes (region_preference, residency_policy, service_role) to decision tokens; added audit-watermark headers and compact audit envelope generation to observability/audit to preserve minimal provenance while reducing header bloat; wired feature flag redwood.feature.kms_contextual_rbac and config knobs for retain_fallback_kms=true/false.

Checklist: [x] design doc linked (Linear ENG-8723) [x] unit + integration tests [x] e2e in-kind smoke tests [x] migration script to populate service-scoped KMS bindings in config DB [x] docs update stub for console settings

Commits (high-level): - 8a3f2b5: introduce kms-proxy service scaffold and dockerfile - b4e6aa1: implement signed claim verifier & route table reconciler - c12d3f4: add contextual rbac evaluator and policy mapper - d9f1e0a: compact audit envelope generation + header watermark tests - f0e9c7b: add e2e smoke and unit tests, update feature flag gating

Files touched (overview): services/kms-proxy/{main.go,proxy.go,policy_verifier.go,Dockerfile}, pkg/auth/rbacv2/{evaluator.go,mapper.go,policy_test.go}, observability/audit/{envelope.go,watermark_test.go}, internal/config/{migrations/20251112_add_service_kms_bindings.sql}, helm/redwood/templates/kms-proxy-deployment.yaml, docs/operations/kms-contextual-routing.md, examples/quickstarts/kms-proxy-example.yaml, test/e2e/kms_proxy_smoke_test.go.

Small illustrative snippet (policy mapper): "role_bindings -> { service: 'model-serving', allowed_key_aliases: ['projects/redwood/keys/reg-*'], residency: 'eu' }". The evaluator converts request attributes into a concise claim: "svc_claim:{svc=model-serving,tenant=acme,region_hint=eu-west-1}" which is signed by the service account before forwarding to the proxy.

Backwards compatibility & migration notes: The feature is behind a feature flag and defaults to disabled. When enabled for a tenant, we run the migration to add service-level KMS bindings. The proxy honors fallback_kms when upstream keys are not region-affine. Operators can enable a 'strict_residency' mode via console which denies fallback.

Testing and CI: Unit coverage added for the evaluator and envelope generator (~82% for modified packages). Integration tests run a local mock KMS and exercise region pinning + fallback. e2e smoke exercise validated that audit watermarks are present and compact envelopes are stored in the audit sink.

Links: Linear ENG-8723, design doc: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-8723/service-bound-kms-proxy-design, runbook stub: docs/operations/kms-contextual-routing.md
